and I came to Yerushalayim, and understood the brokenness that Eliashib had done for Tobiah, in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of Elohim.

Did not Shlomo king of Israel do wrong in these things? yet among many nations was there no king like him, and he was beloved of his God, and Elohim made him king over all Israel: nevertheless even him did foreign women lead into wrongdoing.
YHWH said to the Adversary, "Have you considered my servant, Job? For there is none like him in the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who reveres God, and turns away from harm."
YHWH said to the Adversary, "Behold, all that he has is in your power. Only on himself don't put forth your hand." So the Adversary went forth from the presence of YHWH.

While he was still speaking, there also came another, and said, "The fire of Elohim has fallen from the heavens, and has burned up the sheep and the servants, and consumed them, and I alone have escaped to tell you."
He said, "Naked I came out of my mother's womb, and naked shall I return there. YHWH gave, and YHWH has taken away. Blessed be the name of YHWH."
Again it happened on the day when the Elohim's sons came to present themselves before YHWH, that the Adversary came also among them to present himself before YHWH.

YHWH said to the Adversary, "Have you considered my servant Job? For there is none like him in the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who reveres God, and turns away from harm. He still maintains his integrity, although you incited me against him, to ruin him without cause."
YHWH said to the Adversary, "Behold, he is in your hand. Only spare his life."
So the Adversary went forth from the presence of YHWH, and struck Job with painful sores from the sole of his foot to his head.
Then his wife said to him, "Do you still maintain your integrity? Renounce Elohim, and die."

But he said to her, "You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of Elohim, and shall we not receive adversity?" In all this Job did no wrong with his lips.
"Behold, Elohim will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the people who do wrong.
Elohim, the one who is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who has hardened himself against him, and prospered?
But oh that Elohim would speak, and open his lips against you,
that he would show you the secrets of wisdom! For true wisdom has two sides. Know therefore that Elohim exacts of you less than your iniquity deserves.
Will you speak unrighteously for Elohim, and talk deceitfully for him?
Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for Elohim?
Because he has stretched out his hand against Elohim, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty;
He shall not depart out of darkness. The flame shall dry up his branches. By the breath of Elohim's mouth shall he go away.
know now that Elohim has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.
He has swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again. Elohim will cast them out of his belly.
When he is about to fill his belly, Elohim will cast the fierceness of Elohim’s wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating.
This is the portion of a wicked person from Elohim, the heritage appointed to him by Elohim."
You say, 'Elohim lays up his iniquity for his children.' Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.
Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him, that you make your ways perfect?
You say, 'What does Elohim know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?
"Why aren't times laid up by the Almighty? Why don't those who know him see his days?
Yet Elohim preserves the mighty by Elohim’s power. He rises up who has no assurance of life.
For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when Elohim takes away his life?
Will Elohim hear his cry when trouble comes on him?
Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on Elohim at all times?
To man he said, 'Behold, the fear of YHWH, that is wisdom. To depart from harm is understanding.'"
What then shall I do when Elohim rises up? When he visits, what shall I answer him?
For calamity from Elohim is a terror to me. Because his majesty, I can do nothing.
Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than Elohim.
Beware lest you say, 'We have found wisdom, Elohim may refute him, not man;'
then Elohim is gracious to him, and says, 'Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.'
He prays to Elohim, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.
For he adds rebellion to his wrongdoing. He claps his hands among us, and multiplies his words against Elohim."
Behold, Elohim is great, and we don't know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.
Do you know how Elohim controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?
Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to Elohim, and wander for lack of food?
because Elohim has deprived her of wisdom, neither has he imparted to her understanding.
"Shall the one who argues contend with the Almighty? The one who argues with Elohim, let him answer it."
Or do you have an arm like Elohim? Can you thunder with a voice like him?
He is the chief of the ways of Elohim. The one who made him gives him their sword.
YHWH turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends. YHWH gave Job twice as much as he had before.

Then came there to him all his brothers, and all his sisters, and all those who had been of his acquaintance before, and ate bread with him in his house. They comforted him, and consoled him concerning all the harm that YHWH had brought on him. Everyone also gave him a piece of money, and everyone a ring of gold.
So YHWH blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, one thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand female donkeys.
Many there are who say of my soul, "There is no help for him in Elohim." Selah.
For you will bless the righteous. YHWH, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.
He says in his heart, "Elohim has forgotten. Elohim hides Elohim’s face. Elohim will never see it."
"Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise," says YHWH; "I will set him in safety from those who malign him."
You frustrate the plan of the poor, because YHWH is his refuge.
Arise, YHWH, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword;
YHWH gives great deliverance to YHWH’s king, and shows loving kindness to YHWH’s anointed, to Dawid and to his seed, forevermore.
Now I know that YHWH saves YHWH’s anointed. YHWH will answer him from YHWH’s holy heavens, with the saving strength of YHWH’s right hand.
The king rejoices in your strength, YHWH! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
For the king trusts in YHWH. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.
"He trusts in YHWH; let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him."
For YHWH has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, Neither has YHWH hidden YHWH’s face from him; but when he cried to YHWH, YHWH heard.
He shall receive a blessing from YHWH, righteousness from the God of his salvation.
Redeem Israel, Elohim, out all of his troubles.
This poor man cried, and YHWH heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
YHWH will laugh at him, for YHWH sees that his day is coming.
Be merciful to me, Elohim, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.
He shall be enthroned in Elohim's presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.
But Elohim will strike through the head of Elohim’s enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.
saying, "Elohim has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him."
YHWH also chose Dawid YHWH’s servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;
from following the ewes that have their young, Elohim brought him to be the shepherd of Ya'akov, Elohim’s people, and Israel, Elohim’s inheritance.
He will call to me, 'You are my Cosmic Parent, my God, and the rock of my salvation!'
Like a father has compassion on his children, so YHWH has compassion on those who revere YHWH.
YHWH causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may bring forth food out of the earth:
until the time that his word happened, and YHWH's word proved him true.
YHWH brought them forth with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.
because they were rebellious against YHWH’s spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips.
Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by YHWH. Don't let the wrongdoing of his mother be blotted out.
YHWH is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.
YHWH, remember Dawid and all his affliction,
how he swore to YHWH, and vowed to the Mighty One of Ya'akov:
But overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea; for YHWH’s loving kindness endures forever:
for whom YHWH loves, YHWH reproves; even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.
For the ways of man are before the eyes of YHWH. YHWH examines all his paths.
The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against YHWH.
Reverence for YHWH leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.
lest YHWH see it, and it displease YHWH, and YHWH turn away YHWH’s wrath from him.
for you will heap coals of fire on his head, and YHWH will reward you.
Enter into the rock, and hide in the dust, from before the terror of YHWH, and from the glory of his majesty.
People shall go into the caves of the rocks, and into the holes of the earth, from before the terror of YHWH, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.
To go into the caverns of the rocks, and into the clefts of the ragged rocks, from before the terror of YHWH, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.

For the vineyard of YHWH of Armies is the house of Israel, and the people of Yehudah his pleasant plant: and he looked for justice, but, behold, oppression; for righteousness, but, behold, a cry of distress.
The harp, lyre, tambourine, and flute, with wine, are at their feasts; but they don't regard the work of YHWH, neither have they considered the operation of his hands.
Who say, "Let him make speed, let him hasten his work, that we may see it; and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw near and come, that we may know it!"
In the year that king Uzziyah died, I saw YHWH sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.
He said, "Listen now, house of Dawid: Is it not enough for you to try the patience of people, that you will try the patience of my God also?
Therefore YHWH will give you a sign. Behold, the virgin will conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
I went to the prophetess, and she conceived, and bore a son. Then said YHWH to me, "Call his name 'Maher Shalal Hash Baz.'
now therefore, behold, YHWH brings upon them the mighty flood waters of the River: the king of Ashur and all his glory. It will come up over all its channels, and go over all its banks.
For to us a child is born. To us a son is given; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful, Counselor, Mighty Elohim, Everlasting Cosmic Parent, Prince of Peace.

Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on the throne of Dawid, and on his kingdom, to establish it, and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from that time on, even forever. The zeal of YHWH of Armies will perform this.
Therefore YHWH will set up on high against him the adversaries of Rezin, and will stir up his enemies,

Therefore it will happen that, when YHWH has performed his whole work on Har Tzion and on Yerushalayim, I will punish the fruit of the willful proud heart of the king of Ashur, and the insolence of his haughty looks.
Therefore YHWH, YHWH of Armies, will send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory a burning will be kindled like the burning of fire.
The light of Israel will be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame; and it will burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day.
Therefore YHWH, YHWH of Armies, says "My people who dwell in Tzion, don't be afraid of the Assyrian, though he strike you with the rod, and lift up his staff against you, as Mitzrayim did.
YHWH of Armies will stir up a scourge against him, as in the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb. YHWH’s rod will be over the sea, and YHWH will lift it up like YHWH did against Mitzrayim.
The Ruach of YHWH will rest on him: the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of reverence for YHWH.
His delight will be in reverence for YHWH. He will not judge by the sight of his eyes, neither decide by the hearing of his ears;

YHWH will utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his scorching wind he will wave his hand over the River, and will split it into seven streams, and cause men to march over in sandals.
There will be a highway for the remnant that is left of YHWH’s people from Ashur, like there was for Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Mitzrayim.
Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will be shaken out of its place in the wrath of YHWH of Armies, and in the day of his fierce anger.
For YHWH will have compassion on Ya'akov, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land. The foreigner will join himself with them, and they will unite with the house of Ya'akov.

But now YHWH has spoken, saying, "Within three years, as a worker bound by contract would count them, the glory of Moab shall be brought into contempt, with all his great multitude; and the remnant will be very small and feeble."
The burden of Mitzrayim: "Behold, YHWH rides on a swift cloud, and comes to Mitzrayim. The idols of Mitzrayim will tremble at his presence; and the heart of Mitzrayim will melt in its midst.
YHWH has mixed a spirit of perverseness in the midst of her; and they have caused Mitzrayim to go astray in all of its works, like a drunken man staggers in his vomit.
In that day the Egyptians will be like women. They will tremble and fear because of the shaking of the hand of YHWH of Armies, which he shakes over them.
at that time YHWH spoke by Yeshayahu the son of Amoz, saying, "Go, and loosen the sackcloth from off your waist, and take your shoes from off your feet." He did so, walking naked and barefoot.
For YHWH said to me, "Go, set a watchman. Let him declare what he sees.
He cried like a lion: "YHWH, I stand continually on the watchtower in the daytime, and every night I stay at my post.
YHWH of Armies revealed himself in my ears, "Surely this iniquity will not be forgiven you until you die," says YHWH, YHWH of Armies.
Behold, YHWH will overcome you and hurl you away violently. Yes, he will grasp you firmly.
He has stretched out his hand over the sea. He has shaken the kingdoms. YHWH has ordered the destruction of Kena'an's strongholds.
Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for YHWH of Armies will reign on Har Tzion, and in Yerushalayim; and before his elders will be glory.
For in this mountain the hand of YHWH will rest. Moab will be trodden down in his place, even like straw is trodden down in the water of the dunghill.
Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet he will not learn righteousness. In the land of uprightness he will deal wrongfully, and will not see YHWH's majesty.
In that day, YHWH with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan the twisted serpent; and he will kill the dragon that is in the sea.
Behold, YHWH has a mighty and strong one. Like a storm of hail, a destroying storm, and like a storm of mighty waters overflowing, he will cast them down to the earth with his hand.
For his God instructs him in right judgment, and teaches him.
For YHWH has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep, and has closed your eyes, the prophets; and he has covered your heads, the seers.
Therefore thus says YHWH, who redeemed Avraham, concerning the house of Ya'akov: "Ya'akov shall no longer be ashamed, neither shall his face grow pale.
But when he sees his children, the work of my hands, in the midst of him, they will sanctify my name. Yes, they will sanctify the Holy One of Ya'akov, and will stand in awe of the God of Israel.
For through the voice of YHWH the Assyrian will be dismayed. YHWH will strike him with YHWH’s rod.
Every stroke of the rod of punishment, which YHWH will lay on him, will be with the sound of tambourines and harps. YHWH will fight with them in battles, brandishing weapons.
For his burning place has long been ready. Yes, for the king it is made ready. He has made its pyre deep and large with fire and much wood. YHWH's breath, like a stream of sulfur, kindles it.

For thus says YHWH to me, "As the lion and the young lion growling over his prey, if a multitude of shepherds is called together against him, will not be dismayed at their voice, nor abase himself for the noise of them, so YHWH of Armies will come down to fight on Har Tzion and on its heights.
His rock will pass away by reason of terror, and his princes will be afraid of the banner," says YHWH, whose fire is in Tzion, and YHWH’s furnace in Yerushalayim.
Search in the book of YHWH, and read: not one of these will be missing. none will lack her mate. For my mouth has commanded, and his Ruach has gathered them.
It happened, when king Chizkiyahu heard it, that he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into YHWH's house.

It may be YHWH your God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Ashur his master has sent to defy the living Elohim, and will rebuke the words which YHWH your God has heard. Therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.'"
Now therefore, YHWH our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you are YHWH, even you only."
this is the word which YHWH has spoken concerning him. The virgin daughter of Tzion has despised you and ridiculed you. The daughter of Yerushalayim has shaken her head at you.
Therefore thus says YHWH concerning the king of Ashur, 'He will not come to this city, nor shoot an arrow there, neither will he come before it with shield, nor cast up a mound against it.
By the way that he came, by the same he shall return, and he shall not come to this city,' says YHWH.

It happened, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons struck him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. Esar Haddon his son reigned in his place.
In those days was Chizkiyahu sick and near death. Yeshayahu the prophet, the son of Amoz, came to him, and said to him, "Thus says YHWH, 'Set your house in order, for you will die, and not live.'"
Then Chizkiyahu turned his face to the wall and prayed to YHWH,
Then Chizkiyahu said to Yeshayahu, "YHWH's word which you have spoken is good." He said moreover, "For there will be peace and truth in my days."
Who has worked and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I, YHWH, the first, and with the last, I am he."
YHWH will go out like a mighty man. They will stir up zeal like a warrior. He will raise a war cry. Yes, he will shout aloud. He will triumph over his enemies.

"You are my witnesses," says YHWH, "With my servant whom I have chosen; that you may know and believe me, and understand that I am he. Before me there was no Elohim formed, neither will there be after me.
One will say, 'I am YHWH's;' and another will be called by the name of Ya'akov; and another will write with his hand 'to YHWH,' and honor the name of Israel."
This is what YHWH, the Sovereign of Israel, and his Redeemer, YHWH of Armies, says: "I am the first, and I am the last; and besides me there is no Elohim.

Then it will be for a person to burn; and he takes some of it, and warms himself. Yes, he burns it, and bakes bread. Yes, he makes a god, and worships it; he makes it an engraved image, and falls down to it.
The rest of it he makes into a god, even his engraved image. He bows down to it and worships, and prays to it, and says, "Deliver me; for you are my god!"

Sing, you heavens, for YHWH has done it! Shout, you lower parts of the earth! Break out into singing, you mountains, O forest, all of your trees, for YHWH has redeemed Ya'akov, and will glorify himself in Israel.
Thus says YHWH to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have held, to subdue nations before him, and strip kings of their armor; to open the doors before him, and the gates shall not be shut:
Thus says YHWH, the Holy One of Israel, and his Maker: "You ask me about the things that are to come, concerning my sons, and you command me concerning the work of my hands!
I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will make straight all his ways: he shall build my city, and he shall let my exiles go free, not for price nor reward, says YHWH of Armies.
Only in YHWH, it is said of me, is righteousness and strength; even to him shall people come; and all those who were incensed against him shall be disappointed.
Some pour out gold from the bag, and weigh silver in the balance. They hire a goldsmith, and he makes it a god. They fall down--yes, they worship.
Assemble yourselves, all you, and hear; who among them has declared these things? The one whom YHWH loves shall perform his pleasure on Bavel, and his arm [shall be on] the Chaldeans.
Listen, islands, to me; and listen, you peoples, from far: YHWH has called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother has he made mention of my name:

Thus says YHWH, the Redeemer of Israel, [and] his Holy One, to the one whom man despises, to the one whom the nation abhors, to a servant of rulers: Kings shall see and arise; princes, and they shall worship; because of YHWH who is faithful, [even] the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you.
Who is among you who reveres YHWH, who obeys the voice of YHWH’s servant? The one who walks in darkness, and has no light, let him trust in the name of YHWH, and rely on their God.

For YHWH has comforted Tzion; he has comforted all her waste places, and has made her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of YHWH; joy and gladness shall be found therein, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.

and have forgotten YHWH your Maker, who stretched forth the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth; and fear continually all the day because of the fury of the oppressor, when he makes ready to destroy? and where is the fury of the oppressor?
Awake, awake, stand up, Yerushalayim, that have drunk at the hand of YHWH the cup of his wrath; you have drunken the bowl of the cup of staggering, and drained it.
YHWH has made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
Surely he has borne our sickness, and carried our suffering; yet we considered him plagued, struck by Elohim, and afflicted.
All we like sheep have gone astray. Everyone has turned to their own way; and YHWH has laid on him the iniquity of us all.

Yet it pleased YHWH to bruise him. YHWH has caused him to suffer. When you make his soul a reparation offering, he shall see his seed. He shall prolong his days, and the pleasure of YHWH shall prosper in his hand.
Behold, you shall call a nation that you don't know; and a nation that didn't know you shall run to you, because of YHWH your God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he has glorified you.
let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts; and let him return to YHWH, and YHWH will have mercy on him; and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.
Neither let the foreigner, who has joined himself to YHWH, speak, saying, YHWH will surely separate me from YHWH’s people; neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I am a dry tree.
Also the foreigners who join themselves to YHWH, to minister to him, and to love the name of YHWH, to be their servants, everyone who keeps the Sabbath from profaning it, and holds fast my covenant;
YHWH God, who gathers the outcasts of Israel, says, Yet will I gather [others] to him, besides his own who are gathered.
I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace, to the one who is far off and to the one who is near, says YHWH; and I will heal him.

Is such the fast that I have chosen? the day for a person to afflict their soul? Is it to bow down his head as a rush, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under him? will you call this a fast, and an acceptable day to YHWH?
Then shall you call, and YHWH will answer; you shall cry, and he will say, Here I am. If you take away from the midst of you the yoke, the putting forth of the finger, and speaking wickedly;
Behold, YHWH's hand is not shortened, that it can't save; neither his ear heavy, that it can't hear:
Yes, truth is lacking; and the one who departs from harm makes themselves a prey. YHWH saw it, and it displeased him that there was no justice.
They saw that there was no one, and wondered that there was no intercessor: therefore their own arm brought salvation to him; and God’s righteousness, it upheld God.
So shall they fear the name of YHWH from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun; for YHWH will come as a rushing stream, which the breath of YHWH drives.

The Ruach of YHWH God is on me; because YHWH has anointed me to preach good news to the humble; he has sent me to bind up the broken-hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening [of the prison] to those who are bound;

I will greatly rejoice in YHWH, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation, he has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decks himself with a garland, and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
Behold, YHWH has proclaimed to the end of the earth, Say you to the daughter of Tzion, Behold, your salvation comes; behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.
But they rebelled, and grieved his the Ruach of Elohim: therefore he was turned to be their enemy, [and] himself fought against them.
You shall leave your name for a curse to my chosen; and YHWH God will kill you; and he will call his servants by another name:

Hear the word of YHWH, you who tremble at his word: Your brothers who hate you, who cast you out for my name's sake, have said, Let YHWH be glorified, that we may see your joy; but it is those who shall be disappointed.

You shall see [it], and your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like the tender grass: and the hand of YHWH shall be known toward his servants; and he will have indignation against his enemies.
For, behold, YHWH will come with fire, and his chariots shall be like the whirlwind; to render his anger with fierceness, and his rebuke with flames of fire.
For by fire will YHWH execute judgment, and by his sword, on all flesh; and the slain of YHWH shall be many.
to whom the word of YHWH came in the days of Yoshiyahu the son of Amon, king of Yehudah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
Israel [was] holiness to YHWH, the first fruits of his increase: all who devour him shall be held guilty; trouble shall come on them, says YHWH.

They say, If a man puts away his wife, and she goes from him, and becomes another man's, will they return to her again? Won't that land be greatly polluted? But you have played the prostitute with many lovers; yet return again to me, says YHWH.
Therefore thus says YHWH, Behold, I will lay stumbling blocks before this people; and the fathers and the sons together shall stumble against them; the neighbor and his friend shall perish.
Cut off your hair, [Yerushalayim], and cast it away, and take up a lamentation on the bare heights; for YHWH has rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.

At that time, says YHWH, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Yehudah, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Yerushalayim, out of their graves;

Who is the wise person, that may understand this? and [who is] he to whom the mouth of YHWH has spoken, that he may declare it? why is the land perished and burned up like a wilderness, so that none passes through?
YHWH called your name, A green olive tree, beautiful with goodly fruit: with the noise of a great tumult he has kindled fire on it, and the branches of it are broken.
Are there any among the vanities of the nations that can cause rain? or can the sky give showers? Aren't you he, YHWH our God? therefore we will wait for you; for you have made all these things.
Then came Yirmeyahu from Topheth, where YHWH had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of YHWH's house, and said to all the people:
Then Pashhur struck Yirmeyahu the prophet, and put him in the stocks that were in the upper gate of Binyamin, which was in the house of YHWH.
It happened on the next day, that Pashhur brought forth Yirmeyahu out of the stocks. Then said Yirmeyahu to him, YHWH has not called your name Pashhur, but Magormissabib.

For thus says YHWH, Behold, I will make you a terror to yourself, and to all your friends; and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and your eyes shall see it; and I will give all Yehudah into the hand of the king of Bavel, and he shall carry them captive to Bavel, and shall kill them with the sword.
Let that man be as the cities which YHWH overthrew, and didn't relent: and let him hear a cry in the morning, and shouting at noontime;
The word which came to Yirmeyahu from YHWH, when king Tzidkiyahu sent to him Pashhur the son of Malchijah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, saying,
Please inquire of YHWH for us; for Nebuchadnezzar king of Bavel makes war against us: peradventure YHWH will deal with us according to all YHWH’s wondrous works, that he may go up from us.

Afterward, says YHWH, I will deliver Tzidkiyahu king of Yehudah, and his servants, and the people, even such as are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Bavel, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their life: and he shall strike them with the edge of the sword; he shall not spare them, neither have pity, nor have mercy.
For I have set my face on this city for calamity, and not for good, says YHWH: it shall be given into the hand of the king of Bavel, and he shall burn it with fire.
For thus says YHWH touching Shallum the son of Yoshiyahu, king of Yehudah, who reigned instead of Yoshiyahu his father, [and] who went forth out of this place: He shall not return there any more.
He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then it was well. Wasn't this to know me? says YHWH.

Therefore thus says YHWH concerning Jehoiakim the son of Yoshiyahu, king of Yehudah: they shall not lament for him, [saying], Ah my brother! or, Ah sister! They shall not lament for him, [saying] Ah lord! or, Ah his glory!
Behold, the days come, says YHWH, that I will raise to Dawid a righteous Branch, and he shall reign as king and deal wisely, and shall execute justice and righteousness in the land.
In his days Yehudah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely; and this is his name by which he shall be called: YHWH our righteousness.
For who has stood in the council of YHWH, that he should perceive and hear YHWH’s word? who has marked my word, and heard it?
Can any hide himself in secret places so that I shall not see him? says YHWH. Don't I fill heaven and earth? says YHWH.
The prophet who has a dream, let him tell a dream; and the one who has my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is the straw to the wheat? says YHWH.
Behold, I am against the prophets, says YHWH, who use their tongues, and say, He says.
As for the prophet, and the priest, and the people, who shall say, The burden of YHWH, I will even punish that man and his house.

As the bad figs, which can't be eaten, they are so bad, surely thus says YHWH, So will I give up Tzidkiyahu the king of Yehudah, and his princes, and the residue of Yerushalayim, who remain in this land, and those who dwell in the land of Mitzrayim,

It happened, when Yirmeyahu had made an end of speaking all that YHWH had commanded him to speak to all the people, that the priests and the prophets and all the people laid hold on him, saying, You shall surely die.
Then said the princes and all the people to the priests and to the prophets: This a person is not worthy of death; for he has spoken to us in the name of YHWH our God.

Micah the Morashtite prophesied in the days of Chizkiyahu king of Yehudah; and he spoke to all the people of Yehudah, saying, Thus says YHWH of Armies: Tzion shall be plowed as a field, and Yerushalayim shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.

Did Chizkiyahu king of Yehudah and all Yehudah put him to death? Didn't he revere YHWH, and entreat the favor of YHWH, and YHWH relented from the harm which YHWH had pronounced against them? Thus should we commit great harm against our own souls.

There was also a person who prophesied in the name of YHWH, Uriyah the son of Shemaiah of Kiriath Jearim; and he prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Yirmeyahu:

It shall happen, that the nation and the kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar king of Bavel, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Bavel, that nation will I punish, says YHWH, with the sword, and with the famine, and with the pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.
But the nation that shall bring their neck under the yoke of the king of Bavel, and serve him, that [nation] will I let remain in their own land, says YHWH; and they shall till it, and dwell therein.
The prophet who prophesies of peace, when the word of the prophet shall happen, then shall the prophet be known, that YHWH has truly sent him.

Hananiah spoke in the presence of all the people, saying, Thus says YHWH: Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Bavel within two full years from off the neck of all the nations. The prophet Yirmeyahu went his way.

For thus says YHWH of Armies, the God of Israel: I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Bavel; and they shall serve him: and I have given him the animals of the field also.

Thus says YHWH of Armies, the God of Israel, concerning Achav the son of Kolaiah, and concerning Tzidkiyahu the son of Maaseiah, who prophesy a lie to you in my name: Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Bavel; and he shall kill them before your eyes;

YHWH has made you priest in the place of Yehoyada the priest, that there may be officers in the house of YHWH, for everyone who is mad, and makes themselves a prophet, that you should put him in the stocks and in shackles.
Send to all them of the captivity, saying, Thus says YHWH concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite: Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you, and I didn't send him, and he has caused you to trust in a lie;

therefore thus says YHWH, Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite, and his seed; they shall not have a person to dwell among this people, neither shall they see the good that I will do to my people, says YHWH, because they have spoken rebellion against YHWH.
It shall come to pass in that day, says YHWH of Armies, that I will break his yoke from off your neck, and will burst your bonds; and strangers shall no more make him their bondservant;

Therefore don't you be afraid, O Ya'akov my servant, says YHWH; neither be dismayed, Israel: for, behold, I will save you from afar, and your seed from the land of their captivity; and Ya'akov shall return, and shall be quiet and at ease, and none shall make him afraid.

Thus says YHWH: Behold, I will turn again the captivity of Ya'akov's tents, and have compassion on his dwelling places; and the city shall be built on its own hill, and the palace shall be inhabited after its own manner.

Their prince shall be of themselves, and their ruler shall proceed from the midst of them; and I will cause him to draw near, and they shall approach to me: for who is the one who has had boldness to approach to me? says YHWH.
Behold, the storm of YHWH, [even his] wrath, is gone forth, a sweeping storm: it shall burst on the head of the wicked.
The fierce anger of YHWH shall not return, until he has executed, and until he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days you shall understand it.
Thus says YHWH, The people who were left of the sword found favor in the wilderness; even Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.
Hear the word of YHWH, you nations, and declare it in the islands afar off; and say, The one who scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as shepherd does their flock.
For YHWH has ransomed Ya'akov, and redeemed him from the hand of the one who was stronger than they.
I have surely heard Efrayim bemoaning himself [thus], You have chastised me, and I was chastised, as a calf unaccustomed [to the yoke]: turn you me, and I shall be turned; for you are YHWH my God.
Is Efrayim my dear son? is he a darling child? for as often as I speak against him, I do earnestly remember him still: therefore my heart yearns for him; I will surely have mercy on him, says YHWH.
For Tzidkiyahu king of Yehudah had shut him up, saying, Why do you prophesy, and say, Thus says YHWH, Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Bavel, and he shall take it;
and he shall bring Tzidkiyahu to Bavel, and there shall he be until I visit him, says YHWH: though you fight with the Chaldeans, you shall not prosper?
Therefore thus says YHWH: Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Bavel, and he shall take it:
Moreover the word of YHWH came to Yirmeyahu the second time, while he was yet shut up in the court of the guard, saying,

The word which came to Yirmeyahu from YHWH, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Bavel, and all his army, and all the kingdoms of the earth that were under his dominion, and all the peoples, were fighting against Yerushalayim, and against all the cities of it, saying:

Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel, Go, and speak to Tzidkiyahu king of Yehudah, and tell him, Thus says YHWH, Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Bavel, and he shall burn it with fire:

Yirmeyahu said to the house of the Rechabites, Thus says YHWH of Armies, the God of Israel: Because you have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according to all that he commanded you;
Then Yirmeyahu called Baruch the son of Neriah; and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Yirmeyahu all the words of YHWH, which YHWH had spoken to him, on a scroll of a book.
Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Yirmeyahu the prophet commanded him, reading in the book the words of YHWH in YHWH's house.

Therefore thus says YHWH concerning Jehoiakim king of Yehudah: He shall have none to sit on the throne of Dawid; and his dead body shall be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.
But neither he, nor his servants, nor the people of the land, did listen to the words of YHWH, which YHWH spoke by the prophet Yirmeyahu.

Then Tzidkiyahu the king sent, and fetched him: and the king asked him secretly in his house, and said, Is there any word from YHWH? Yirmeyahu said, There is. He said also, You shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Bavel.

Thus says YHWH, The one who remains in this city shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence; but the one who goes forth to the Chaldeans shall live, and their life shall be to him for a prey, and they shall live.
Thus says YHWH, This city shall surely be given into the hand of the army of the king of Bavel, and he shall take it.
Then Tzidkiyahu the king sent, and took Yirmeyahu the prophet to him into the third entry that is in the house of YHWH: and the king said to Yirmeyahu, I will ask you a thing; hide nothing from me.
Now the word of YHWH came to Yirmeyahu, while he was shut up in the court of the guard, saying,

The word which came to Yirmeyahu from YHWH, after that Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah, when he had taken him being bound in chains among all the captives of Yerushalayim and Yehudah, who were carried away captive to Bavel.
The captain of the guard took Yirmeyahu, and said to him, YHWH your God pronounced this calamity on this place;
and said to them, Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to present your supplication before him:
Don't be afraid of the king of Bavel, of whom you are afraid; don't be afraid of him, says YHWH: for I am with you to save you, and to deliver you from his hand.
and I have this day declared it to you; but you have not obeyed the voice of YHWH your God in anything for which he has sent me to you.
It happened that, when Yirmeyahu had made an end of speaking to all the people all the words of YHWH their God, with which YHWH their God had sent him to them, even all these words,

and tell them, Thus says YHWH of Armies, the God of Israel: Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadnezzar the king of Bavel, my servant, and will set his throne on these stones that I have hidden; and he shall spread his royal pavilion over them.

The incense that you burned in the cities of Yehudah, and in the streets of Yerushalayim, you and your fathers, your kings and your princes, and the people of the land, didn't YHWH remember them, and didn't it come into his mind?

Thus says YHWH, Behold, I will give Pharaoh Hophra king of Mitzrayim into the hand of his enemies, and into the hand of those who seek his life; as I gave Tzidkiyahu king of Yehudah into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Bavel, who was his enemy, and sought his life.
Thus shall you tell him, Thus says YHWH: Behold, that which I have built will I break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up; and this in the whole land.

For that day is [a day] of YHWH, YHWH of Armies, a day of vengeance, that he may avenge him of his adversaries: and the sword shall devour and be satiate, and shall drink its fill of their blood; for YHWH, YHWH of Armies, has a sacrifice in the north country by the river Perat.
As I live, says the Sovereign, whose name is YHWH of Armies, surely like Tabor among the mountains, and like Carmel by the sea, so shall he come.
YHWH of Armies, the God of Israel, says: Behold, I will punish Amon of No, and Pharaoh, and Mitzrayim, with her gods, and her kings; even Pharaoh, and those who trust in him:

and I will deliver them into the hand of those who seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Bavel, and into the hand of his servants; and afterwards it shall be inhabited, as in the days of old, says YHWH.
How can you be quiet, seeing YHWH has given you a charge? Against Ashqelon, and against the seashore, there has he appointed it.
Therefore, behold, the days come, says YHWH, that I will send to him those who pour off, and they shall pour him off; and they shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles in pieces.
Moab is laid waste, and they are gone up into his cities, and his chosen young people are gone down to the slaughter, says the Sovereign, whose name is YHWH of Armies.
The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, says YHWH.
Make you him drunken; for he magnified himself against YHWH: and Moab shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.
I know his wrath, says YHWH, that it is nothing; his boastings have worked nothing.
For thus says YHWH: Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread out his wings against Moab.
Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he has magnified himself against YHWH.

The one who flees from the fear shall fall into the pit; and the one who gets up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring on him, even on Moab, the year of their visitation, says YHWH.
Of the children of Ammon. Thus says YHWH: Has Israel no sons? has he no heir? why then does Malcam possess Gad, and his people well in the cities of it?

Therefore, behold, the days come, says YHWH, that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard against Rabbah of the children of Ammon; and it shall become a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Israel possess those who did possess him, says YHWH.

Therefore hear the counsel of YHWH, that YHWH has taken against Edom; and YHWH’s purposes, that YHWH has purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely they shall drag them away, [even] the little ones of the flock; surely he shall make their habitation desolate over them.
Therefore thus says YHWH of Armies, the God of Israel: Behold, I will punish the king of Bavel and his land, as I have punished the king of Ashur.
The voice of those who flee and escape out of the land of Bavel, to declare in Tzion the vengeance of YHWH our God, the vengeance of his temple.

Therefore hear the counsel of YHWH, that YHWH has taken against Bavel; and YHWH’s purposes, that YHWH has purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely they shall drag them away, [even] the little ones of the flock; surely he shall make their habitation desolate over them.
For Israel is not forsaken, nor Yehudah, of his God, of YHWH of Armies; though their land is full of guilt against the Holy One of Israel.
Flee out of the midst of Bavel, and save everyone their life; don't be cut off in her iniquity: for it is the time of YHWH's vengeance; he will render to her a recompense.

Make sharp the arrows; hold firm the shields: YHWH has stirred up the spirit of the kings of the Medes; because his purpose is against Bavel, to destroy it: for it is the vengeance of YHWH, the vengeance of his temple.

Set up a standard against the walls of Bavel, make the watch strong, set the watchmen, prepare the ambushes; for YHWH has both purposed and done that which he spoke concerning the inhabitants of Bavel.
He did what was broken in the sight of YHWH, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
and he burned the house of YHWH, and the king's house; and all the houses of Yerushalayim, even every great house, burned he with fire.
Her filthiness was in her skirts; she didn't remember her latter end; therefore is she come down wonderfully; she has no comforter: see, YHWH, my affliction; for the enemy has magnified himself.
Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look, and see if there be any sorrow like my sorrow, which is brought on me, With which YHWH has afflicted [me] in the day of his fierce anger.

The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand; They are knit together, they are come up on my neck; he has made my strength to fail: YHWH has delivered me into their hands, against whom I am not able to stand.

Tzion spreads forth her hands; there is none to comfort her; YHWH has commanded concerning Ya'akov, that those who are round about him should be his adversaries: Yerushalayim is among them as an unclean thing.

YHWH is become as an enemy, YHWH has swallowed up Israel; YHWH has swallowed up all her palaces, YHWH has destroyed his strongholds; YHWH has multiplied in the daughter of Yehudah mourning and lamentation.
Her gates are sunk into the ground; he has destroyed and broken her bars: Her king and her princes are among the nations where the law is not; Yes, her prophets find no vision from YHWH.

Arise, cry out in the night, at the beginning of the watches; Pour out your heart like water before the face of YHWH: Lift up your hands toward him for the life of your young children, that faint for hunger at the head of every street.
YHWH is my portion, says my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of YHWH, was taken in their pits; Of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the nations.
the word of YHWH came expressly to Yechezkel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of YHWH was there on him.

But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall tell them, Thus says YHWH God: The one who hears, let him hear; and the one who forbears, let him forbear: for they are a rebellious house.

He put forth the form of a hand, and took me by a lock of my head; and the Ruach lifted me up between earth and the sky, and brought me in the visions of Elohim to Yerushalayim, to the door of the gate of the inner [court] that looks toward the north; where was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy.
Then he brought me to the door of the gate of YHWH's house which was toward the north; and see, there sat the women weeping for Tammuz.

He brought me into the inner court of YHWH's house; and see, at the door of the temple of YHWH, between the porch and the altar, were about twenty-five men, with their backs toward the temple of YHWH, and their faces toward the east; and they were worshipping the sun toward the east.

YHWH said to him, Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Yerushalayim, and set a mark on the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry over all the abominations that are done in the midst of it.

Then said he to me, The iniquity of the house of Israel and Yehudah is exceedingly great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perversion: for they say, YHWH has forsaken the land, and YHWH doesn't see.

Therefore speak to them, and tell them, Thus says YHWH God: Everyone of the house of Israel who takes their idols into their heart, and puts the stumbling block of their iniquity before their face, and comes to the prophet; I YHWH will answer him therein according to the multitude of his idols;

For everyone of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who sojourn in Israel, who separates themselves from me, and takes their idols into their heart, and puts the stumbling block of their iniquity before their face, and comes to the prophet to inquire for themselves of me; I YHWH will answer him by myself:
and I will set my face against that man, and will make him an astonishment, for a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of my people; and you shall know that I am YHWH.
If the prophet be deceived and speak a word, I, YHWH, have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand on him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.

Say you, Thus says YHWH God: Shall it prosper? shall he not pull up the roots of it, and cut off the fruit of it, that it may wither; that all its fresh springing leaves may wither? and not by a strong arm or much people can it be raised from the roots of it.
As I live, says YHWH God, surely in the place where the king dwells who made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he broke, even with him in the midst of Bavel he shall die.
Therefore thus says YHWH God: As I live, surely my oath that he has despised, and my covenant that he has broken, I will even bring it on his own head.
All his fugitives in all his bands shall fall by the sword, and those who remain shall be scattered toward every wind: and you shall know that I, YHWH, have spoken it.
has walked in my statutes, and has kept my ordinances, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live, says YHWH God.
Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked? says YHWH God; and not rather that he should return from his way, and live?
Then said I, Ah YHWH God! they say of me, Isn't he a speaker of parables?
Thus shall Yechezkel be to you a sign; according to all that he has done shall you do: when this comes, then shall you know that I am YHWH God.
Thus says YHWH God: Because Edom has dealt against the house of Yehudah by taking vengeance, and has greatly offended, and revenged himself on them;
Child of humanity, take up a lamentation over the king of Tzor, and tell him, Thus says YHWH God: You seal up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.

Speak and say, 'Thus says YHWH God: "Behold, I am against you, Pharaoh king of Mitzrayim, the great monster that lies in the midst of his rivers, that has said, 'My river is my own, and I have made it for myself.'
The land of Mitzrayim shall be a desolation and a waste; and they shall know that I am YHWH. Because he has said, 'The river is mine, and I have made it;'

Therefore thus says YHWH God: Behold, I will give the land of Mitzrayim to Nebuchadnezzar king of Bavel; and he shall carry off her multitude, and take her spoil, and take her prey; and it shall be the wages for his army.
I have given him the land of Mitzrayim as his recompense for which he served, because they worked for me, says YHWH God.
Therefore thus says YHWH God: Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Mitzrayim, and will break his arms, the strong [arm], and that which was broken; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.

I will hold up the arms of the king of Bavel; and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down; and they shall know that I am YHWH, when I shall put my sword into the hand of the king of Bavel, and he shall stretch it out on the land of Mitzrayim.
Therefore thus said YHWH God: Because you are exalted in stature, and he has set his top among the thick boughs, and his heart is lifted up in his height;

Thus says YHWH God: In the day when he went down to Sheol I caused a mourning: I covered the deep for him, and I restrained the rivers of it; and the great waters were stayed; and I caused Levanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.

To whom are you thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? yet shall you be brought down with the trees of Eden to the lower parts of the earth: you shall lie in the midst of the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, says YHWH God.
Pharaoh shall see them, and shall be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword, says YHWH God.
For I have put his terror in the land of the living; and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude, says YHWH God.

Tell them, As I live, says YHWH God, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn you, turn you from your broken ways; for why will you die, house of Israel?

Now the hand of YHWH had been on me in the evening, before the one who was escaped came; and he had opened my mouth, until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no more mute.
He said to me, Child of humanity, can these bones live? I answered, YHWH God, you know.
Again he said to me, Prophesy over these bones, and tell them, you dry bones, hear the word of YHWH.
Then said he to me, Prophesy to the wind, prophesy, child of humanity, and tell the wind, Thus says YHWH God: Come from the four winds, breath, and breathe on these slain, that they may live.

tell them, Thus says YHWH God: Behold, I will take the stick of Yosef, which is in the hand of Efrayim, and the tribes of Israel his companions; and I will put them with it, [even] with the stick of Yehudah, and make them one stick, and they shall be one in my hand.
Thus says YHWH God: Are you he of whom I spoke in old time by my servants the prophets of Israel, who prophesied in those days for [many] years that I would bring you against them?
I will call for a sword against him to all my mountains, says YHWH God: everyone's sword shall be against their brother.
In the visions of Elohim brought he me into the land of Israel, and set me down on a very high mountain, whereon was as it were the frame of a city on the south.
